title: Terms and Conditions for Insight The City and ITC Club
content:
# Terms and Conditions for Insight The City and ITC Club

**Version:** October 27, 2026

These Terms govern use of the Insight The City app, personal accounts, ITC Club membership, and access to Club benefits. Read them together with the Membership Terms, the conditions of each benefit, and the Privacy Policy made available in the app.

# 1. Operator and scope

The Insight The City app and ITC Club membership program are operated by **Eventland LLC**, a limited liability company organized under the laws of New Jersey, United States. In these Terms, "Eventland," "ITC," "we," "us," and "our" refer to Eventland LLC as the operator of these services.

Participating businesses and experience providers are referred to as "Establishments" or "Partners." These descriptions identify a commercial collaboration. They do not, by themselves, make an Establishment an owner, employee, legal partner, or agent of Eventland.

These Terms govern our relationship with users and members. Purchases and services obtained directly from an Establishment are also governed by that Establishment's disclosed conditions and applicable law.

# 2. Acceptance and related documents

You will have access to these Terms before being asked to accept them for account registration or another feature requiring acceptance. If you do not accept, you may not use features subject to that acceptance.

The Membership Terms govern subscription billing, renewal, promotional access, cancellation, and refunds. Conditions displayed for a particular benefit govern that offer's activation and redemption. A specific promotional offer accepted before activation governs the promotion within its disclosed scope. These documents must be read together, without reducing mandatory consumer protections or changing an accepted offer retroactively.

The Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled. **Accepting these Terms does not replace separate permissions or consents required for Yorki, location access, or other processing.**

Creating an account or accepting these Terms does not, by itself, authorize a subscription, recurring payment, or price increase. Paid subscriptions require the additional authorization described before purchase.

# 3. Eligibility and personal accounts

To create an account or subscribe, you must be **at least 18 years old**, have reached the age of majority in your jurisdiction of residence, and have the legal capacity to enter into a contract.

Provide accurate account information and keep it current. Protect your credentials and contact us if you suspect unauthorized access. Do not lend, sell, or transfer your account, impersonate another person, or create additional accounts to bypass offer restrictions.

An Establishment may impose higher age limits or other admission requirements for particular products or activities. Membership does not override identification, age, accessibility, reservation, legal, or safety requirements disclosed for an offer.

# 4. Free content and paid membership

The app provides free content, including news, information, events, and listings of Club benefits. Some features require an account. An ITC Club subscription is optional and is not required to view the available free content.

**Yorki is available as a free feature and does not require a paid ITC Club membership.** Its account requirements and separate consent for processing information through OpenAI remain applicable, as explained in Section 12 and the Privacy Policy.

Viewing a benefit does not entitle you to redeem it. Redemption requires an active membership or valid promotional access and compliance with the offer's conditions.

An event listing does not mean that admission is included in membership, that it is a Club benefit, or that Eventland organizes it. Any relevant inclusion or role will be identified in the listing or offer.

# 5. Monthly membership, payments, and renewal

The standard membership costs **US$4.99 per month**, in United States dollars. This is the final membership price; ITC does not add taxes or other charges to that fee. Prices and charges for purchases from Establishments are separate.

Payment of the membership fee provides access to **all benefits available and included in ITC Club** during the membership period, subject to each offer's conditions. It does not automatically pay for tickets, meals, products, reservations, or experiences unless an offer expressly states that an item is included or free.

Membership payments are processed through Stripe. You must provide a valid payment method that you are authorized to use. Activation of a paid membership requires a completed and verifiable payment.

When available at checkout, you may choose Link, Stripe's service for saving and reusing payment information. **Using Link is optional** and is governed by the provider's applicable terms and privacy notice presented for that service. Your choice to use Link is separate from your authorization of the ITC Club subscription and recurring charges. The Privacy Policy explains the contact, billing, and payment information that Stripe or Link may make available to ITC.

Membership **renews automatically each month for US$4.99 until you cancel automatic renewal**, subject to your express authorization. Before requesting payment information and consent, we will clearly disclose the price, billing frequency, relevant dates or deadlines, cancellation method, and applicable promotional conditions.

You will receive a confirmation you can retain containing the subscription terms and cancellation instructions. Your membership period and next billing date will be disclosed when you subscribe and in the confirmation. A billing month does not necessarily equal 30 days.

If a renewal payment cannot be verified, **access continues until the current membership period expires**. After that period, benefits requiring membership are suspended until you provide a valid payment method and the corresponding payment is completed and verified. Adding a card without completing payment does not reactivate membership. Suspension does not replace cancellation of automatic renewal.

You may cancel automatic renewal at any time through the subscription cancellation option in the app, including **Profile > My Membership**. Cancellation will also be available through the same digital channels used to subscribe and will not require a phone call or support conversation as a mandatory step. To avoid the next charge, cancel before the renewal date and time disclosed for your subscription; no additional notice of several days is required.

Cancellation stops future renewals and allows access until the current period ends, subject to each benefit's conditions. Canceling membership does not delete your account.

**ITC does not offer discretionary refunds** for cancellation, nonuse, partial use, or the unused portion of a membership period. Billing errors, duplicate or unauthorized charges, charges following a timely cancellation, and refunds or other remedies arising from ITC's breach or applicable law will be addressed as required. The complete Membership Terms provide further details.

# 6. Free trials and invitation-only promotions

The standard plan does not include a free trial. ITC may offer trials to selected users through promotional invitations and determines the recipients and conditions of each promotion.

Before activation, we will disclose the trial's duration, eligibility requirements, any invitation deadline, the first billing date, the subsequent price, and cancellation instructions. A 30-day trial applies only if expressly offered in the invitation. **The trial begins when you activate the promotional membership**, not when you receive the invitation.

A trial linked to the monthly subscription requires a valid payment method and express authorization for subsequent charges. At the end of the trial, US$4.99 will be charged and membership will renew monthly unless canceled before the first charge. If you cancel during the trial, access continues until the granted free period ends.

Eligibility and repeat-use limits are those stated in the invitation. Activated trial conditions will be honored for the granted period. For trials longer than one month, a reminder with cancellation instructions will be sent between 3 and 21 days before the deadline for avoiding the first charge, in addition to any other legally required notice.

# 7. Conditions for using benefits

To redeem a benefit, you must hold an active membership or valid promotional access and comply with the conditions displayed for that offer. Relevant restrictions must be disclosed before activation, reservation, or payment. They may include:

- Eligible locations, dates, and hours.
- Advance reservations, capacity, and availability.
- Minimum spending and included or excluded products.
- Activation frequency and redemption limits.
- Rules for guests, family members, and combining promotions.
- Age, identification, admission, and activity requirements.

Membership, QR codes, discount codes, and Club benefits are personal and nontransferable. They may not be sold, lent, shared publicly, or used to allow someone else to redeem independently of the member.

If an offer expressly includes guests or family members, the member may use that arrangement within its conditions. This does not transfer membership or authorize a third party's independent use.

# 8. QR code activation and expiration

**QR codes expire 24 hours after activation.** An expired code cannot be used. Activation frequency and the permitted number of redemptions are those specified for each benefit.

Present the code according to the app and Establishment's instructions. Do not alter it, reproduce it for unauthorized use, transfer it, manipulate redemption records, or use it after its permitted redemptions have been exhausted.

Activating a QR code does not make a reservation, purchase a ticket, or guarantee availability beyond the offer's published conditions. It does not extend membership: **your membership must remain active when you redeem the benefit**, even if the code is less than 24 hours old.

If an ITC technical issue prevents use of a valid code, contact support for review. Expiration rules do not eliminate remedies arising from ITC's failure to fulfill its obligations.

The Privacy Policy explains how codes are linked to accounts for validation and internal analytics and what information an Establishment can access when scanning them.

# 9. Independent Establishments, purchases, and experience safety

**Eventland sells and administers the ITC Club membership. The identified Establishment sells and provides its own products and services.** Purchases of tickets, experiences, food, products, or services are made directly from the Establishment, at its premises or through its sales channels.

Each Establishment is responsible for its operations, including its premises, equipment, staff, food preparation and handling, service delivery, safety procedures, permits, licenses, and compliance with applicable laws. It also manages its prices, reservations, changes, cancellations, and refunds under its disclosed conditions and the law.

Establishments are responsible for any ingredient, allergen, admission, accessibility, age, or safety information they are required to provide. Direct specific questions about a product or activity to the provider before purchasing or participating.

Listing, selecting, recommending, or promoting an Establishment, providing a discount, or receiving a fee or commission **does not by itself make Eventland the owner, operator, organizer, supervisor, or provider of that Establishment's activity**. Publication of an offer does not constitute a certification by ITC of the safety or regulatory compliance of the premises, food, equipment, or activity.

Claims arising from an Establishment's food, premises, equipment, personnel, or operation must be assessed according to the conduct of that Establishment and any other legally responsible party. Eventland does not assume responsibility for an Establishment's acts or omissions solely because a user discovered, booked, purchased, or redeemed an offer through ITC Club.

**Eventland remains responsible for its own acts, omissions, and obligations under applicable law.** This section does not release Eventland from responsibility the law assigns to it or prevent a user from bringing a claim against a legally responsible party. Responsibility depends on the actual facts and roles, including any role Eventland expressly undertakes for a particular activity.

Before paying an Establishment, review its final price, included items, reservation and refund policies, and offer conditions. Taxes, service charges, tips, and additional items are included in a benefit only if expressly stated.

# 10. Benefit problems and incident reports

If a valid benefit does not work, an Establishment refuses it, or its conditions differ from the published offer, contact **ITCClub@insightthecity.com** or the support channel indicated in the app. Whenever possible, report the issue before completing a purchase or proceeding with a redemption that does not match the offer.

We may request relevant details, such as the Establishment, date, benefit, error message, offer screenshot, or receipt. Do not send passwords, full payment card numbers, or unnecessary sensitive information.

ITC will review the report and, where appropriate, coordinate with the Establishment to apply the offer or correct the issue. When published conditions and expressly disclosed availability requirements are met, the benefit must be honored as offered.

You may also report an incident involving an Establishment to ITC. We may seek relevant information, contact the provider, or restrict or remove an offer while reviewing it. Our support process does not replace the provider's incident procedures or determine legal responsibility.

A purchase from an Establishment does not automatically create an obligation for Eventland to refund that purchase. Eventland remains responsible for its own commitments and applicable remedies.

Seeking our help is not a prerequisite to contacting an authority, filing a claim, exercising legal rights, or expressing an honest opinion. Support is not an emergency response service; do not wait for our reply when immediate assistance is needed.

# 11. Benefit availability and catalog changes

The catalog may add, update, or remove Establishments and offers. Each offer is subject to its clearly disclosed conditions. Membership does not guarantee a specific amount of savings or the indefinite availability of a particular Establishment or benefit unless expressly promised when you subscribe.

Changes will be reflected in the app and may not retroactively alter a purchase or reservation already confirmed with an Establishment. Activation alone is not a confirmed reservation or purchase unless an offer expressly states otherwise.

Catalog changes do not authorize withdrawal of services expressly promised as part of a paid membership. If a change or interruption materially prevents use of the subscribed service, ITC will review the appropriate solution, including remedies under the Membership Terms and applicable law.

# 12. Yorki and artificial intelligence

Yorki is an AI assistant that uses OpenAI's API to provide suggestions and information about things to do, weather, benefits, discounts, and itinerary planning.

**Yorki's responses are generated automatically and may contain errors, omissions, or outdated information.** Check relevant prices, schedules, availability, weather advisories, restrictions, and booking details with the Establishment, organizer, or appropriate official source before acting on a response.

A response, suggested itinerary, or recommendation does not by itself make a reservation, purchase admission, confirm availability, or change an Establishment's offer conditions. Yorki cannot override eligibility, membership, redemption, or legal requirements.

Before sharing information with OpenAI, the app requests your specific choice to accept or decline the processing necessary to use Yorki. **Unless and until you accept, our integration does not send your messages or the context described in the Privacy Policy to OpenAI.** If you decline, Yorki cannot generate responses through that service.

The Privacy Policy describes the information shared, conversation history, retention, providers, and how to request withdrawal of consent or deletion. Acceptance of these Terms does not replace that specific consent.

Provide only information you are authorized to submit. Do not include passwords, full card numbers, identity documents, or unnecessary sensitive information. You retain any rights you have in content you submit. Any permission to process that content is limited to providing and administering the requested feature and the purposes described in the Privacy Policy, subject to required permissions and legal obligations.

# 13. Commercial relationships and commissions

ITC maintains commercial agreements with participating businesses. Some pay to participate, others participate by invitation without a fee, and Eventland may receive commissions from purchases or reservations made through links or codes, or other consideration for a collaboration.

When disclosure of a commercial relationship is required, it will appear clearly and prominently in the relevant profile, benefit, link, or content. This general explanation does not replace offer-specific disclosures.

Compensation does not, by itself, make Eventland the provider of an Establishment's service or change the price shown to you. Applicable prices and charges must be disclosed in the offer and purchasing channel.

# 14. Intellectual property and permitted use

Trademarks, text, photographs, videos, designs, and other materials belong to their respective rights holders or are used with permission. These Terms do not assign Eventland ownership of rights belonging to other persons, Partners, or rights holders associated with Insight The City.

You may view content for personal use and use the sharing features provided. Other reproduction, distribution, or commercial exploitation of protected material requires permission, except where allowed by law.

You may not:

- Access another person's account or interfere with account security.
- Manipulate benefits, QR codes, payment status, or redemption records.
- Use automated extraction methods that violate rights or access controls.
- Disrupt the app, introduce harmful code, or bypass technical safeguards.
- Submit unlawful content or use the services to infringe another person's rights.
- Use the services for fraud or other unlawful activity.

Software downloaded through an app store is also subject to the applicable store license and usage rules. For Apple App Store downloads, Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement applies where no separate custom software license is provided. These Terms govern ITC's services and membership and do not reduce mandatory consumer rights or Eventland's express commitments.

# 15. Information, external services, and availability

News, event details, opening hours, prices, and location information may change after publication. We will review errors brought to our attention. Before traveling or purchasing, confirm relevant details with the organizer, Establishment, or authoritative source.

Maps and nearby-place results are informational and depend on the location or search reference used. Device permissions and the Privacy Policy govern location processing.

External websites, booking platforms, and services are operated by their respective providers under their own terms and privacy notices. ITC remains responsible for obligations arising from its own services and conduct.

The app may require updates or maintenance or experience technical interruptions. We will seek to correct issues within our control and communicate significant interruptions where possible. An interruption does not eliminate commitments undertaken for a paid membership or remedies available under the Membership Terms and applicable law.

# 16. Account restrictions, suspension, and deletion

Eventland may take proportionate measures when there are reasonable grounds involving fraud, unauthorized benefit transfers, manipulation of redemptions, security risks, serious or repeated violations of these Terms, or a legal obligation.

Unless an urgent security issue or legal restriction prevents it, we will explain the reason and provide a way to request review or correct the problem. We will not suspend an account solely for a legitimate complaint or an honest negative opinion.

Suspension for misuse is separate from suspension for an unpaid renewal under Section 5. Neither eliminates rights concerning improper charges or ITC's breach.

You may initiate account deletion through the clearly visible option in the app or the deletion page identified in the Privacy Policy. Emailing support is not required to initiate deletion.

The deletion process blocks account access, initiates cancellation of the associated subscription in Stripe, and manages deletion of applicable account data and files. We confirm when the process is complete. If cancellation cannot be confirmed or another issue occurs, a request may require a retry; blocked access alone does not establish that cancellation is complete. Contact us if you do not receive confirmation or still see an active subscription. A technical failure does not authorize improper charges or delay rights established by law.

Deletion ends access to features and benefits requiring the account, even if time remains in the current period. **To stop renewal while retaining access until membership expires, cancel only the subscription renewal and keep your account.**

Account deletion does not automatically cancel purchases or reservations made directly with an Establishment. Data retention, legal exceptions, and backup cycles are described in the Privacy Policy.

**Signing out or uninstalling the app does not cancel membership or delete your account.**

If Eventland discontinues a membership or the service, it must address billing and any amounts due under the agreed conditions and applicable law. Termination does not extinguish outstanding obligations or rights already acquired.

# 17. Responsibility and consumer rights

Each party remains responsible for its own obligations and conduct. Eventland does not assume an Establishment's exclusive obligations merely by including it in the Club, and remains responsible for its own legal and contractual obligations regarding the app, membership, and any services it actually undertakes.

These Terms do not impose a general waiver of claims for injury or loss, exclude liability for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, or other conduct for which liability cannot lawfully be excluded, or eliminate remedies provided by law.

New Jersey consumers retain the rights and remedies available under the Consumer Fraud Act, the Truth-in-Consumer Contract, Warranty and Notice Act, and other applicable laws. Users elsewhere retain their mandatory protections, including those of New York where applicable.

No rule on redemption, suspension, catalog changes, refunds, external providers, or support may be interpreted to exclude Eventland's legally imposed responsibility for its own conduct or prevent a user from contacting authorities or courts.

# 18. Privacy and communications

The Privacy Policy explains the data we process, its purposes, providers, retention, permissions, and rights-request channels. Privacy requests may be sent to **info@insightthecity.com**.

We may send communications necessary to administer accounts, memberships, payments, redemptions, security, requests, and contractual updates. Promotional communications and device notification permissions are managed through the relevant preferences and unsubscribe options.

Membership does not require you to accept advertising. Unsubscribing from promotional emails does not cancel membership, and canceling membership does not by itself delete the account or unsubscribe you from marketing. Use the relevant controls for each action.

# 19. Changes to these Terms and subscription conditions

We will publish updated versions with their dates and communicate material changes before they apply. Changes will not retroactively alter earlier events, claims, paid periods, or trials already granted.

Material changes to an automatic renewal offer, including price changes, will be disclosed at least 5 business days and no more than 30 days before they take effect, subject to any additional legal requirements. **Before charging an existing subscriber a higher price, ITC will request express consent.** If you do not accept, the increased price will not be charged, and we will explain the effect on the next renewal. Access continues until the current period expires.

Other material changes will be communicated reasonably in advance, subject to mandatory notice requirements. Urgent security measures or changes legally required to take immediate effect will be handled consistently with applicable law and existing consumer rights.

Continuing to use the app or accepting an updated version of its general terms does not, by itself, authorize new charges. We will request renewed acceptance where required and honor commitments already made for paid membership periods.

# 20. Governing law, complaints, and severability

These Terms are governed by the laws of New Jersey, without overriding mandatory consumer protections or applicable rules on jurisdiction and venue.

You may contact Eventland to try to resolve a disagreement. Doing so is voluntary and is not a prerequisite to filing a complaint with an authority or bringing a claim before a court with jurisdiction.

**These Terms do not impose mandatory arbitration, a class action waiver, or a waiver of a trial where legally available.**

If a provision is held invalid, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the extent they can operate independently and preserve the agreement's purpose. An invalid obligation may not be restored through an interpretation that conflicts with applicable law.

# 21. Contact and notices

**Operator:** Eventland LLC.

**Services:** Insight The City app and ITC Club membership.

**Location:** New Jersey, United States.

**Support, membership, and complaints:** ITCClub@insightthecity.com.

**Privacy and personal data requests:** info@insightthecity.com.

Service of legal process and other communications requiring a specific legal form must follow applicable procedures. The support email does not replace those procedures.
